description:
Open the Chinook database in LibreOffice Base and use the SQL execution tool (Tools > SQL) to perform three bulk data corrections:

1. EMPLOYEE TABLE: Update all employees with Title 'Sales Support Agent' to 'Customer Service Representative'.
2. CUSTOMER TABLE: Update all customers with Country 'USA' to 'United States'.
3. TRACK TABLE: Update the UnitPrice to 1.19 for all tracks in the Rock genre (GenreId = 1) that currently have a UnitPrice of 0.99.

Execute these UPDATE statements. Verify your changes if desired. Finally, SAVE the database (File > Save) and CLOSE LibreOffice Base to ensure all changes are permanently written to the file.
